games.title: Gluttonography
games.description: A mysterious dog has appeared out of nowhere. It looks like it feeds on photographs of food. Interesting.

games.title: Frame or Die
games.description: The poor little Chick, still in its Egg, fell out of the nest. Move small frames around the big world to manipulate it, allowing Little Egg Chick to get back to the nest.

games.title: Big World Rally
games.description:
Requires a controller with triggers, shoulder buttons and analog sticks to play.

Right Trigger: Throttle

Left Trigger: Brake

Left Shoulder: Clutch

Left Stick: Steering

Right Stick: Gear stick (when clutch is pressed)

games.title: The Undelivered
games.description:
You are a detective. Across the table sits a suspect. Between you: one small clue — an undelivered letter, a missing package, a stamped envelope with no destination.

Through conversation alone, you must uncover the big world of crime, cover-ups, and very human secrets hiding behind it.
